text: 【多机构预测上半年GDP增速超4.5% 下半年关键看出口和房地产】从目前已披露的机构预测来看，二季度经济增速大概率较一季度有所回落。多家研究机构预计，二季度GDP同比增长4.2%至4.5%，上半年GDP增速则有望保持在4.5%至4.7%区间。多家机构认为，随着逆周期调节力度加大，财政政策进一步发力、重大项目建设提速，以及促消费、稳投资等政策持续落地，三、四季度经济增速有望较二季度小幅回升，全年GDP增速预计在4.7%左右。
text_en: Multiple institutions predict H1 GDP growth exceeding 4.5%; H2 performance hinges on exports and real estate. From disclosed institutional forecasts, Q2 GDP growth is likely to moderate from Q1. Many research institutions expect Q2 GDP to grow 4.2%-4.5% YoY, with H1 GDP estimated to stay in the 4.5%-4.7% range. Institutions believe that with intensified counter-cyclical adjustments, further fiscal policy efforts, accelerated major project construction, and sustained implementation of consumption-boosting and investment-stabilizing policies, Q3 and Q4 GDP growth may slightly rebound from Q2. Full-year GDP growth is projected at around 4.7%.
